verdict.top_defect: Option 1 validates against ephemeral .claude/runs state and publishes a checkpoint schema with no field for cross-run inheritance, so the durable Tier-4 artifact silently asserts the current run produced gates it inherited — the same provenance falsification option 3 was rejected for, moved one artifact downstream.

Option 1 relaxes only the input check, so the write-once phase8_checkpoint.json still asserts bootstrapped gates under the current run_id with no field recording the difference — relocating option 3's provenance falsification into the durable close artifact, unrecoverably, while the authorizing record lives only in clearable .claude/runs/ state.

As worded, option 1 validates against `.claude/runs/` — §9.2 disposable runtime memory — so the durable Tier-4 checkpoint asserts a provenance chain that becomes unverifiable once the run dir is cleared; the contract must also record {original_run_id, evidence_path, input_fingerprint, versions} into the checkpoint itself.
